description: Draft and manage outreach messages to people at companies: accept the terms, draft, edit, redraft, discard, record the outcome and close a thread; build Mailbox campaigns, choose their message, edit or remove their emails and cancel them. Standard drafts first emails to the hiring contacts it revealed; sending, the terms, outcomes and campaigns are Premium. Sending is send_email send_outreach or send_campaign. Actions: accept_terms, draft, edit, discard, regenerate, resolve, close_thread, create_campaign, choose_campaign_template, retry_campaign_templates, write_campaign_emails, edit_campaign_email, cancel_campaign. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

campaign_id.description: A campaign's id from get_outreach campaigns (campaigns[].id).

outreach_id.description: An outreach message or thread id from get_outreach.

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

target_id.description: One campaign email's id from get_outreach campaign or campaign_targets (targets[].id).

name: manage_outreach
title: Manage outreach
